apps.releaseBody:
> [!NOTE]

This is a known blocker, flagged for a future fix in storytold/craft-common-actions#39. FreeBSD x86_64 and every other platform are included.


## What's Changed
* security: write files atomically through an exclusive temp file (CWE-59) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1840
* security: do not follow directory symlinks in cargo xtask stats (CWE-400) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1845
* security: bound geometry-kernel degree and work (CWE-407) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1848
* security: bound drawing document-model work and allocation (CWE-400/407) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1850
* security: budget the rendering pipeline against DoS geometry (CWE-400/407/789) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1849
* security: bound constraint-engine work and allocation (CWE-400/407) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1851
* security: authenticate the local control server with a per-session token (CWE-306) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1844
* security: bound native DXF/SVG/PDF import allocation and quadratic work (CWE-400/407/789) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1846
* security: bound Lisp callbacks, native comparisons, and local file reads (CWE-400, CWE-407) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1842
* security: bound font outline geometry and MTEXT line scanning (CWE-400/407) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1852
* security: guard the DXF->DWG conversion input and document decoder limits (CWE-789) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1847
* security: submit XATTACH picked path as literal text, not a command line (CWE-74) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1843
* security: confine craft-fonts manifest paths and reject newline Cargo directives (CWE-22, CWE-74) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1841


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/compare/v0.11.0...v0.12.0

> [!NOTE]
> **FreeBSD aarch64 is dropped from this release.** We had to cut releases, and we cannot build this target within the 5-hour CI limit for any of the Craft apps, so we are dropping it for now. This is a known blocker, flagged for a future fix in storytold/craft-common-actions#39. FreeBSD x86_64 and every other platform are included.

* README: the app icon above the title by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1049
